name: Du Huan in the lands of the Caliph
summary: Captured when an Abbasid army defeats the Tang at the Talas river, a Chinese officer spends eleven years in the new Islamic empire. He describes Kufa, its mosques and markets, Chinese weavers and painters at work there, and a land called Molin, perhaps in Africa. He comes home by sea to Guangzhou, and his relative Du You preserves part of his record.

stops.note: Taken prisoner when Gao Xianzhi's army is defeated.
